#include <iostream>
#include <string>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    std::string line;
    std::getline(std::cin, line);
    int n = std::stoi(line);
    std::getline(std::cin, line);
    std::string text = line;

    std::vector<std::string> insideWords;
    std::string currentWord;
    int outsideLength = 0;
    int maxOutsideLength = 0;
    bool insideParentheses = false;

    int i = 0;
    while (i < n) {
        char ch = text[i];

        if (ch == '(') {
            if (outsideLength >= maxOutsideLength) {
                maxOutsideLength = outsideLength;
            }
            outsideLength = 0;
            insideParentheses = true;
        } else if (ch == ')') {
            insideParentheses = false;
            if (!currentWord.empty()) {
                insideWords.push_back(currentWord);
                currentWord.clear();
            }
        } else if (insideParentheses) {
            if (ch != '_') {
                currentWord += ch;
            } else if (!currentWord.empty()) {
                insideWords.push_back(currentWord);
                currentWord.clear();
            }
        } else if (ch != '_') {
            outsideLength++;
            if (i == n - 1 && outsideLength >= maxOutsideLength) {
                maxOutsideLength = outsideLength;
            }
        } else {
            if (outsideLength >= maxOutsideLength) {
                maxOutsideLength = outsideLength;
            }
            outsideLength = 0;
        }

        i++;
    }

    std::cout << maxOutsideLength << " " << insideWords.size() << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
